title: Identify magnetism from a diagram
statement:
A molecule has six electrons in bonding MOs and two in antibonding MOs, with all occupied orbitals paired. What does the model predict?

[_]{a}

explanations: Four is the difference before division.
All the electrons are stated to be paired.
Both the division and pairing conclusions are incorrect.

solution: Calculate the occupancy difference. Divide it by two. Check the pairing condition separately. (6−2)/2=2, with no unpaired electrons.
